fusions.name: Rolling Swell
fusions.desc: Hurls a slow swell that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that and leaving each [Stalled] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Drifting Mist
fusions.desc: Breathes a mist in a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 3 damage to everything in it, each with a 30% chance to be [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Mending
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Weathered Bulk
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
